    Radical sandwiches at the ends of a critical BGRS path #

    For a critical singular path, both one-arrow truncations have nonzero ray value while the full path has zero ray value and a nonzero ordinary lift. Consequently the last BGRS product, in either association, is exceptional. Unfolding that exceptional product gives the endpoint instances P₁ and Pₙ₋₁ of BGRS Section 4.2: the lifted full composite is a nonzero sandwich through the Jacobson radical at either adjacent interior vertex.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.BGRSCriticalPathSpine.lift_pathMap_eq_last_prefix {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {i j : RayVertex (BGRSRayCategory C)} {p : Quiver.Path i j} (spine : BGRSCriticalPathSpine p) :
    spine.lift.pathMap p = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (spine.lift.representative spine.last) (spine.lift.pathMap (spine.first.toPath.comp spine.middle))

    The ordinary full composite is the last representative followed by the ordinary first--middle prefix composite.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.BGRSCriticalPathSpine.exists_terminal_radical_sandwich {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [HasWellDefinedBGRSRayProduct C] {i j : RayVertex (BGRSRayCategory C)} {p : Quiver.Path i j} (spine : BGRSCriticalPathSpine p) :
    ∃ (ρ : ↥(Ring.jacobson (CategoryTheory.End spine.rightInner.obj.as))), spine.lift.pathMap p = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (spine.lift.representative spine.last) (↑ρ).asHom) (spine.lift.pathMap (spine.first.toPath.comp spine.middle)) ∧ CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (spine.lift.representative spine.last) (↑ρ).asHom) (spine.lift.pathMap (spine.first.toPath.comp spine.middle)) ≠ 0
